    Silver Talon Guard¶

    [!INFO] The Dwarven Talon — Silver That Weighs True Every Talon cut is a promise the assayer will stand behind.

    History¶

    The military-commercial guard of the Silver Republic in East Erisdar — the property-franchise republic of Argentport whose Council of Eighty rules by land, not birth. The Guard's formal title is Guard of the Argent Assay, founded when the Republic's founding families realized that a coin trusted from Silver Republic to New Mann required guards as honest as its weigh-masters.

    Dwaven partnership is the soul of the formation: assay offices in Dwarvengor weigh every Silver Talon — alloyed silver with a trace blue-glancing Romanium — and claw-cut underweight coins on the spot. The Guard provides the arms that make that honesty stick. It garrisons the argentite mines, the coastal shipyards that build the fastest hulls on the Silver Coast, and the banking houses that, during the Era of Cracking Walls, financed both sides of imperial succession disputes and discovered the business model still works.

    The Guard's motto, adopted from a dwarven foreman's rebuke — if you cannot weigh it, you cannot guard it — is stitched inside every standard.

    Patron¶

    The Silver Republic's Council of Eighty and, spiritually, Pitra — the legendary figure of Pitraism whose faith declares the gods love money and gold, borrowing its pantheon from the dwarves with Dwarvengor as theological lender. Dwarven inspiration is not hidden; the Guard's chaplains are Pitraist and dwarf-friend alike, and no guardsman confuses the arrangement: Pitra blesses the weighing because dwarves invented the scale.

    Sigil¶

    A silver talon clutching a blue-flecked shard on a charcoal field, the shard rendered with a single Romanium-blue highlight that catches light when standards are silk. Financial detachments add a small assay scissors beneath the talon — the claw-cut promise. The Silver Bride appears nowhere; the Guard's pride is that its silver is earthly, not heavenly, and can be weighed.

    Role¶

    Mine garrison, bullion escort, and coastal defense. The Talon Guard fields heavy dwarven-drilled infantry, assay clerks who are also crossbowmen, and a small marine contingent that rides Silver Republic hulls as supercargo-guards. It does not seek battle for glory — it seeks audit: holding a mine until the count is certified, holding a quay until the silver is aboard, holding a debt until it is paid.

    In the field beyond the Republic — in Fractured Erislod, New Mann, Away, and the ports where Spasian merchants grudgingly quote Talons to be taken seriously — the Guard operates as armed factor, not occupier.

    Relation to Currencies & Regions¶

    The Guard is the sword behind the Silver Talon — the most honest coin in the east. Backed by silver + Romanium trace and enforced by the Dwarvengor assay, the Talon is the currency Spasians ban at the border and smuggle anyway. The Guard's treasury settles in Talons first and converts to Erilia only when trading west of Central Erisdar; its officers can quote spreads to Alegorian Crown and West Erisdarian Guilder from memory because they have carried both home as receipts.

    Its great rivalry is not with any army but with counterfeit Talons — most stamped in Pilferhorn and washed through Demon's Horn traders who will honor either coin long enough to sell you the wrong one.
